test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss computation by composing a CTC graph with emissions and checking forward scores
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG loss computation by composing emissions, transitions, and FAL graphs and verifying gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions and transitions graphs and checking the predicted label sequence
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a probability vector with configurable time steps and num classes
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target sequence and blank label for sequence modeling
